hero.title: TopCV, Canva CVs still rejected?
hero.subtitle: Over 41% of Vietnamese companies use AI to screen CVs. Beautiful templates are not enough. FastRezu helps you write achievement content (VI/EN) that beats both Machines (ATS) and People.
hero.description: Other tools help you "check" CVs. FastRezu guides you to write CVs from scratch. We turn your experience into achievements with metrics, optimize JD keywords, and help you get interview invitations.

companies.title: Some companies that are applying AI in their recruitment process

painPoints.sectionDescription: According to 2024 survey, 41% of Vietnamese businesses use AI for recruitment. ATS systems (like Base, MISA, Talent Solution) automatically read, score, and rank your resume.

pain1.title: Hard to express achievements?
pain1.description: The biggest challenge is turning "tasks" into "achievements with metrics". Competitor's AI can check, but FastRezu's AI will write for you.

pain2.title: Filtered out for missing keywords
pain2.description: Your CV (though beautiful) is rejected due to missing JD-matching keywords. FastRezu automatically scans JD and integrates keywords into your CV content.

pain3.title: Beautiful template but ATS can't read
pain3.description: Many beautiful CVs (from Canva, TopCV) use columns, tables, icons that make ATS unable to read content correctly. FastRezu ensures CVs are both beautiful and ATS-compliant.

features.sectionTitleBreak: FastRezu helps you write and optimize.
features.sectionDescription: We don't just score existing CVs. We provide comprehensive AI tools to create outstanding CVs (VI/EN), solving the pain of "word block" and "showing achievements".

feature1.title: AI highlights Achievements
feature1.description: Solving the biggest pain: Just enter the position, AI automatically drafts impressive achievement bullet points (VI/EN) using metrics and strong verbs.

feature2.title: AI deep JD analysis
feature2.description: Automatically "scans" JD, points out important keywords. Helps you customize CV to job focus in seconds.

feature3.title: Check CV & ATS Scoring
feature3.description: Upload existing CV (from TopCV, Canva) for AI scoring, detect ATS errors, and get specific improvement suggestions.

cta.title: Ready for your CV to get recruiter attention.
